notes.title: The Future of Paint Desk Simulator
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We at Splat Games want to start by thanking you for taking an interest in Paint Desk Simulator. We are so happy to see people enjoying the game. We have spent many hours working on it and it has been a passion project of ours. 

As you all have seen, Paint Desk Simulator has not had any updates in the past few months, and we sincerely apologize. PDS has been put on the back burner for us as we have taken on jobs and schooling. At Splat Games, there are only two of us. One of us is working full-time and the other is working two part-time jobs and finishing up their last year of college.

While we want PDS to be a fun experience and bug-free overall, the game has been a little too much for us to handle at the moment. We have lowered the price of PDS to $1.99 for the time being, and have a sale going on to make it even cheaper. 

We know PDS is nowhere near completed at the moment, there is still a lot to experience within the game. It's slightly buggy, but overall, the game is still functional. 

We know there is a sharp learning curve in the game that hinders a lot of new players, and when we have time, we will address that with an in-depth tutorial to help the player understand the gameplay mechanics as some of it is not as intuitive as it should be. There are some things that should have more UX in mind. After that, we do plan to work on employees, but there is no timeline set for the release of either update.

Overall, Paint Desk Simulator will remain in its current state for a while, however, it is not a forgotten project. Each purchase supports us and allows you to enjoy a game made by two college-aged indie developers. 

Thank you all for taking the time to appreciate our game, we sincerely are honored to have you with us along the journey. 

~ Splat Games

notes.title: Paint Desk Simulator is now available!!!
notes.notes:
Finally, the time is here. Paint Desk Simulator is available in its beta state! We are so excited to share with you all the work we have put into the game to give to you all. Now, as game developers, we sometimes don't see flaws or imperfections of the game, we may not have seen some mistakes made (especially the script writer). As usual, the beta does not include everything that the full game will include. Such as employees and the second world titled "Paintsville". 

Now for some plugs/announcements

[url=https://discord.gg/Z8MMnhhFAc]Discord[/url]- Please, join our Discord, it is the easiest way to communicate with us and the community! Any bug reports is best reported here! Along with this, we are hosting giveaways for our community members, as we have already given away some keys right before release! 

For everyone considering or have purchased this game- This is Splat Games' first ever release, we expect flaws, imperfections, and well, to be upfront, we expect to have messed up... a lot. We are super excited to even have your eyes on this game. This was a passion project and has made it's way to the Steam Store. As we are a very small team of developers, we may take some time for updates, but we are sure to keep our community in the loop. Everyone here is awesome, and we hope to get to be able to know you all.

Finally, we hope you enjoy what is Paint Desk Simulator at the moment, as this game means so much to us. Thank you for your time and consideration into this game. Thank you for being with us every big moment of our development. Thank you all.

~Splat Games

notes.title: Paint Desk Simulator Roadmap and Announcements
notes.notes:
Welcome Paint Slingers!

We are excited to talk about Paint Desk Simulator and the updates coming along with it!


First and foremost, we are super happy to announce Paint Desk Simulator for public release soon. During our soft launch for the alpha, we received amazing feedback and want to strive for perfection when it comes to catering to our fanbase. During the alpha, we received many ideas that we never thought of and got right into implementing them into our game. 

The planned date for the beta release of Paint Desk Simulator is early October. Set your calendar for October 9th, however, that is subject to change! We want the game to be in a perfect state when it is released for its beta launch. We do not want to disappoint our audience when it comes to the release, so if we deem it not worthy of release yet, we will withhold it. We want a quality game, not a game made just as a cash grab.

Secondly, we would like to announce the roadmap for Paint Desk Simulator. - [url=https://app.loopedin.io/paint-desk-simulator]LINK TO ROADMAP[/url] - This roadmap shows what is coming to the game for the main release in December. We are adding things as we go, so there are a lot of updates coming out, but everything will not be implemented until our main release on December 21st. 

Also, we would enjoy your company in our public discord for Paint Desk Simulator. - [url=https://discord.gg/VaqKfsMfzJ]LINK FOR DISCORD[/url] - This Discord server is a great opportunity to get your voice heard! We are often active on the server and want your feedback on what to improve and what you want added. Along with this, we also host giveaways! If you would like a chance to be a part of a community and potentially earn free things, join us! We are more than happy to have your company!

Finally, we would like to address something! This game is a passion project for us two. We have sunk our time into this game and we are very proud of the result. Starting this game, we both had no knowledge of game development or game design. We really hope you like what we have created for you all. We have looked at a lot of games in our genre to get an understanding of pricing for these types of games. We noticed most games like this are upwards of $15.00, which is CRAZY! We do not want to charge even close to this price for our game. We like to justify purchases by saying "Will I get at least $1 per hour played?" And personally, we think this game will have more value than $1 per hour. The price for this game will be $3.99 USD. 

Thank you all for being a part of this great community, and we are both excited to see how the game is received by the community! Be sure to wishlist the game so you can see when the beta release is launched!
